steps.en: Officer opens the manual HST revival screen at any time
steps.id: Officer membuka layar revival HST manual kapan saja

steps.en: Officer looks up the ID and OCMS confirms it is under HST
steps.id: Officer mencari ID dan OCMS memastikan ID itu ada di HST

steps.en: Suspension on all notices under the ID is lifted immediately
steps.id: Suspension pada semua notice di bawah ID dicabut langsung

steps.en: The special indicator is removed from the ID
